commands.root: wrahost — publishes Windows apps as RemoteApp
commands.list: Lists the apps published as RemoteApp
commands.publish: Publishes (or updates) an app as RemoteApp
commands.check: Checks whether the host is ready for RemoteApp
commands.prepare: Enables RDP, NLA, the allow list and the firewall (idempotent)
commands.discover: Lists the installed apps (Start menu) that can be published
commands.inspect: Shows what would be published from a shortcut or program (read-only)
commands.icon: Exports the icon of a published app as PNG
commands.agentShow: Shows the port, pairing and certificate fingerprint
commands.agentToken: Generates a new pairing token (the previous one stops working)
commands.agentReset: Deletes the agent token, port and certificate (clients will need to pair again)
commands.langbar: Floating language bar in RemoteApp sessions (current user)
commands.langbarHide: Hides the language bar for the current user
commands.langbarShow: Restores the Windows default for the current user
commands.langbarStatus: Shows whether the bar is hidden for the current user
commands.sessions: Lists the host's user sessions (diagnostics, read-only)
options.name: Display name
options.alias: Alias (generated from the name if omitted)
output.list.name: NAME
